name: 无情风云
group_note: 无情风云 (郑州风云世纪珍藏版), in-game banner reads 《天下无敌》, a Gu Long (古龙)-themed MUD. Boots and completes registration cleanly under WASM with zero compile or runtime errors -- no LPC bugs found anywhere. Only action taken: seeded fluffos (admin) in adm/etc/wizlist (SECURITY_D correctly points at /adm/daemons/securityd, only one copy exists, no decoy). Note: password policy is strict here (must contain uppercase, lowercase, AND a special character/digit, minimum 6 chars) -- a plain alphanumeric password is rejected with '您的密码必需包含大写和小写英文字母和其它特殊符号'; this is intentional site policy, not a bug. Registration flow verified end-to-end in one continuous WASM client session: English id -> y/n create-confirm -> Chinese name (rejects Gu Long novel character names, not tested) -> single password + confirm (not a dual admin/regular password scheme, unlike the sjsh/tybxjh family) -> email -> gender (m/f) -> ethnicity selection (0-3) -> enters world with a full character sheet, zero unexpected errors. Admin permission directly confirmed via 'wizlist' command output showing '目前权限：(admin)'. LPC formatter run across all 7339 .lpc files (7310 written, 24 errors on messy legacy code, 5 unchanged). No :: parent-call split hits, no CJK-respacing hits, no case-label-with-trailing-comment candidates. Both map.lpc files confirmed content-identical (whitespace-only) to their pre-format blobs. Post-formatter re-verified with the same full registration flow -- clean, admin permission still (admin).
